source: Barker et al. 2021, Scientific Reports 11, Figure 7: Time-calibrated spinosaurid tree with continent icons and silhouettes, 15 tips. Matrix spellings: Wight_A and Wight_B are the printed Ceratosuchops and Riparovenator (sister taxa, so the pairing does not affect the topology; the matrix does not say which is which), ML_1190_cf_Baryonyx (printed ML 1190 cf. Baryonyx), Spinosaurus_B. Other_megalosauroids is a collapsed outgroup and keeps its printed text. Image: page render of the image area at 300 dpi, as printed (2101x1576 px). Gold tree and name list from the Open Paleo corpus session (2026-10-29).
